in_sanskrit.name: सर्जन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who creates or originates. A leader, founder, or instigator.

in_hindi.name: सर्जन
in_hindi.long_meaning: सृज् (sṛj) - to create, generate, or produce.

in_tamil.name: சர்ஜன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: செல்லில் (cellil) - to send, dispatch. அழிக்கப்படும் (azhikkappadum) - one who sends, dispatches or delivers.

in_telugu.name: శజన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: శజజ్జేశ్వర (śajajjēśvara) - Lord of all creation, the originator.

in_marathi.name: Sarjan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Creator, Producer, Sower
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sarjan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who creates or produces, a sower, a cultivator, a provider, one who sets things in motion or starts a process.

in_bengali.name: Sarjan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Creator, Producer, Sower
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sarjan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who creates or produces, a sower, a cultivator, a provider, one who sets things in motion or starts a process.
